summary: Comprehensive redesign audit completed. Desktop/mobile UI, all routes, blog, contact, FAQ, theme consistency, and API error handling tested. Known external blocker: Shopify store HTTP 402 (no credentials). All testable functionality working correctly with honest unavailable states.

EXTERNAL: No Shopify credentials configured (SHOPIFY_STOREFRONT_ACCESS_TOKEN, SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID, etc.)

known_legacy_issue: FAQ states 30-day return policy, but Shipping page states 7-day return window - requires owner confirmation before changing legal terms
working_correctly: Desktop and mobile responsive design (1920, 390, 375 widths tested)
Blog functionality (search, filters, articles, TOC, share)
Contact form (creates draft, does NOT send)
Theme consistency (cream, Comfortaa, burnt orange, near-black)

Honest unavailable states (no fake products, no simulated success)
No demo imports in production code
